top_signals.title: European Stocks Muted as Deutsche Telekom Gains on Elliott Stake
top_signals.summary: European stocks were steady on Thursday as oil and bond markets stabilized, while Deutsche Telekom AG gained on news that activist investor Elliott Investment Management has built a sizeable stake.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Malaysia Holds Rate, Tweaks Wording to Signal Price Pressure
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s central bank extended a more than year-long pause in interest rates but tweaked its monetary policy statement to remove a reference to its stance as being “appropriate”, in a possible signal that borrowing costs may rise.

Britain’s biggest meatpacker eyes profit surge after ditching vegan arm
top_signals.summary: The UK’s biggest meatpacker has upgraded its profit target after offloading its loss-making vegan arm. FTSE 250 listed Hilton, which packages beef, lamb and fish, said it now expected to make a pre-tax profit of between £66m and £71m, a 10 per cent uplift from its previous forecast range.
